notes.title: Constance is going to release on November 24, 2025
notes.notes:
Hey all,



We can't wait for you to finally dive fully into the world of Constance on November 24, 2025!

We are super excited for everybody to finally discover all the levels, enemies, NPCs, bosses, secrets, music, challenges, stories and secrets we've created over the last 3 years!

We will be back with more news when they're ready!

Talk soon,
Sebastian - Director for Constance

notes.title: Constance is a beautiful, hand-drawn metroidvania that actually has a release date
notes.notes:
Now, I'm not naming any names here, but there's a certain hand-drawn metroidvania that everyone's a bit sick of waiting for by this point, and could really do with a release date. OK, fine, yes it's Hollow Knight: Silksong, and if those recent Steam backend updates mean anything, I expect it'll get some kind of update sometime in the next few days. In the meantime, here's Constance, also a hand-drawn metroidvania, that actually does have a release date.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (0.2.1)
notes.notes:
Hiii,
we just released a new demo update on Steam! It’s mainly a collection of fixes and tweaks based on community feedback and issues we noticed during Gamescom.
Check it out! 🙂

Patch notes

 The Low Health Effect (visuals & audio) now fades out over time, maintaining the initial impact but gradually fading into the background if you can't heal quickly.
 Fixed an issue where the Corruption/Low Health vignette displayed a large black blob in the center of the screen on some devices.
 Fixed stab direction input when using the D-Pad.
 Fixed collision issues (player being crushed when dash at a wall, bonking the ground after a dive, hitting a horizontal secret wall with an upward stab).
 Fixed the speedrun timer not restarting properly
 Minor level design adjustments.
 Various minor visual fixes.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (v2311161734)
notes.notes:
As we showcase Constance at Vienna Comic Con this weekend, we're releasing a small update for the demo. 
The main change is with the Slice mechanic – now, it activates instantly without needing to enter aim mode. Let us know what you think!

Patch notes

 Reworked the Slice ability to trigger instantly. 
The slice destination is now indicated by a purple arrow.
 Reduced slice cooldown
 Wall hits now come with added knockback effects.
 Allow jump cancel during melee attacks
 Reduced projectile knockback
 Improved camera movement
 A bunch of changes under the hood (engine update, new audiosystem, etc.)

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (v2309051032)
notes.notes:
Introduced "Speedrun Mode", which can be activated via the Settings Menu. When active, the current time is always displayed in the top-right corner.
 Accessing the Settings Menu no longer pauses the Speedrun timer.
 The Speedrun timer now pauses during level loading.
 Added D-Pad support.
 improved clarity of the selected option on the Game Over screen.
 The current build version is now displayed in the bottom-left corner of the start menu.
 Removed "Respawn" Button from Settings menu
 After respawning, Constance will now gain a few invincibility frames
